objective: Canonical proof promotion may evolve without breaking Gemini or Base44.

consume: low-volume commercial/order status metadata supplied by CACE
PROOF_READY_FOR_SALE only after CACE establishes it

compatibility_rules: Internal proof promotion may change theorem source, proof contracts, ledger entries, qualification workflows/artifacts, or canonical hashes without requiring external-client changes when typed projections remain compatible.
Removing/renaming/retyping/changing meaning of an external field requires explicit version transition.
Unknown proof/evidence states must render conservatively and never map to PASS/FORMAL.
Gemini/Base44 must not hard-code proof artifact SHAs, qualification run IDs, or internal Lean paths.
Proof promotion never changes account entitlements, external-builder permissions, or Base44 credit policy.

enterprise_order_mapping.rule: Base44 mirrors CACE-supplied order status; it never computes proof promotion eligibility.
